_comment: Repeat rule (Nick, 2026-09-30): a player may appear again; the SAME STAT for the same player may not appear in two lists in a row. Each entry records the player, the stat (finding ruleKey or a short stat label) and the list date. Only entries from the most recent list date block, and only for the same stat.
_howto: Add every item the day it goes out: {"name": "Player Name", "stat": "ruleKey or stat label", "posted": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
